text.content:
The founder of the Co-Prosperity Sphere.

Role: Exec (historical)
Affiliation: The Nakagawa Foundation; the Night City Co-Prosperity Sphere

In the Time of the Red, Nakagawa talked a group of Japanese firms into the Night City Co-Prosperity Sphere and rebuilt a home for the diaspora, with the Tyger Claws as its sword. The current Claw leader is the third Shinobu.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.01, 04
